title: RNA-seq of human BM-derived mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) cocultured with mouse BM cells upon GM-CSF stimulation against MSCs without  BM cell coculture
description: The paracrine factors are to be identified from MSCs that induce BM cell differentiation during inflammation.

samples.title: MSC cocultured with BM cells with GM-CSF
samples.description: Protocols: Human BM-derived MSCs were either cultured alone without GM-CSF, cultured with GM-CSF, or cocultured with mouse (B6 strain) BM cells in the presence of GM-CSF. For RNA extraction, the cells were lysed in RNA isolation reagent (RNA Bee, Tel-Test Inc., Friendswood, TX), and total RNA was extracted using RNeasy Mini kit (Qiagen, Valencia, CA). The quality of RNA was checked using Agilent’s 2100 Bioanalyzer System and determined appropriate for further assays if all of the following three standards met: 1) Conc. > 100 ng/ul (total > 500 ng), 2) OD 260/280 > 1.8, OD 260/230 > 1.6, 3) Ratio (28s/18s) > 1.5, RIN value > 7.0 Nucleic acid library was constructed by using Quant-Seq library Prep kit (Lexogen).
attributes: cocultured with mouse BM cells in the presence of GM-CSF
mesenchymal stem cell of the bone marrow
